decisions.reviewNotes: Two independent fetches of the provider-owned referral page agree that psychiatry referrals are accepted from GPs and other registered health professionals and that psychiatry self-referrals are not accepted. The practice separately accepts psychotherapy self-referrals, so the corrected first step is explicitly limited to psychiatry.

The provider-owned home and referral pages publish contact and referral details but no explicit current accepting, waitlist, paused, or closed statement. Availability remains not_published and needs manual review rather than being inferred from silence.
